summary_1line: Arjuna kills Jayadratha through Krishna’s stratagem; he spares Kripa in remorse while Satyaki duels Karna and temporarily makes him carless.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna’s arrow carries Jayadratha’s severed head through the sky and drops it into his father Vriddhakshatra’s lap during evening prayers.
Satyaki on Krishna’s radiant chariot clashes with Karna as arrows streak between them while silent armies watch the duel.
Satyaki cuts down Karna’s charioteer and horses, leaving Karna standing weapon in hand beside his shattered chariot.
